courses.title: Osteo-lifting
courses.summary: Deep tissue facial release and biodynamic facial lifting.

sections.heading: Deep tissue facial release (1 day)
items: Myofascial internet theory. The role of fascia in the structural and mental architecture of the patient.
The influence of fascia on all body systems. What is direct fascial influence and how to build a dialog with the body on this principle.
Ergonomics and the use of the body and leverage for effective action.
sections.note: Practical application of theory and direct fascial techniques. All practice is supervised and accompanied by a teacher

sections.heading: Biodynamic facial lifting (2 day)
items: Theory of body architecture through the concepts of volume and vectors.
Theory of interrelationships and interaction between specialist and patient.
Theory about the internal movement and self-regulation process of the body.
Theory about Neutrality during and after the reception of the patient.
Principles of leverage for bioenergetic cheneling.
Principles of motivating the body to self-regulate.
Theory about release and stages determining this process
sections.note: Practical application of what has been learned. All practical activities are supervised by the teacher.

courses.metaDescription: Two-day training: deep tissue facial release and biodynamic facial lifting. Teacher — Ariel Pelevin.

courses.title: Osteo-lifting 3D

items: Advanced techniques in biodynamic approach.
Exploring a more volumetric and multivectoral approach in the biodynamic approach.
Intraoral correction of bones, tissues and membranes.
The use of verbal support during psychosomatic therapy.
Theory about 4-dimensional perception in the process of therapy
sections.note: Supporting the teacher in all stages of learning.

courses.metaDescription: Advanced techniques in the biodynamic approach: multivectoral approach, intraoral correction of bones, tissues and membranes. Instructor — Ariel Pelevin.

How to determine the vectors of tension in and outside the body

How to enter the volume and determine tension at different depths.
How to eliminate these tensions effortlessly using special biodynamic techniques and ligament-fascia untwisting.
How to eliminate body tensions that cause facial distortions and asymmetry.

courses.title: Osteo-dance
courses.summary: Unique method invented by Dr Ariel Pelevin.
paragraphs: Unique method invented by Dr Ariel Pelevin inspired by osteopathic and holistic approaches aims to bring body to self healing process through authentic rythmical movements performed by specialist on body of patient.

Specialist in special way with his hands with light and pulsating touch bring different parts of patient body to amplitude waves which helps to nervous system recognize physical and psychosomatic blocs and eliminates them reducing chronic pains and limitation in movement.
For the observer it's looks like passively instructed contemporary dance

It may apply to everyone - stand, side, lay positions with no need taking clothes off great tool for massage, movement, yoga, psychosomatic therapists as well for ordinary people with no experience at all

During 3hr master class you gonna learn special ergonomics and principles of Osteo- dance. Frequency, amplitude, rythm as a comprehensive and effective tools influencing the body structures in addition to how be able to lead the body to different angle movement or position in order to achieve better release and therapeutic effect.
This method is sufficient for use in all kind of practices as well in home usage for family and kids helping to manage different chronic and psychosomatic disorders.
You advised to bring convenient clothes and footwear
You can film during the master class
You will try all this tech on each other and be able to treat others at the same day
courses.metaDescription: A 3-hour master class in the special ergonomics and principles of Osteo-dance — frequency, amplitude, rhythm. For everyone, including complete beginners.

courses.title: Tai Chi PRO massage
courses.summary: The author's method by Ariel Pelevin.
courses.lead: The author's method by Ariel Pelevin.
paragraphs: This method is based on multi-articular and volumetric ergonomics, which allows the forearms to have a unique effect on the patient's body. Through a special volumetric movement from qigong, which is an energy potential, a specialist can, through rhythm changes, have both sedative and stimulating effects on the patient's body. The change of rhythm transmitted through the forearms helps the specialist to solve many different tasks in massage from SPA to sports and toning effects. At the same time, without overloading your levers and maintaining and even increasing your internal energy potential.

items.name: Alexander Smetana
body: Hello Ariel I would like to express my gratitude once again for your hard work and support in our training 🤲🏻
Based on feedback from colleagues who attended your seminars on Osteo-Lifting a couple of years ago, I decided to go ahead and attend, and I was not disappointed...

My request was more for health and recovery, as I work as a physical therapist, and for patients, I needed to work with the skull, muscles, and TMJ, and I had doubts that this was exactly what would help me and suit me.

But after completing the first seminar, I began to perform so-called miracles ✨✨✨✨😁. Patients began to feel relaxation in their neck and facial muscles during the first sessions, and many experienced relief from migraines 🤕 and general body tension 🤲🏻.

The second module gave me the opportunity to work at a deeper level and address issues not only related to beauty, but also to health. I am grateful to the universe and to you for giving me the opportunity to participate in the Osteo-Lifting and Osteo-Body training programs.

items.name: Valeria
body: I recently attended Ariel Pelevin's "Osteopathic Facelift" seminar for the first time, and it was amazing! 🌿

This was my first experience participating in such a training event, and I am still impressed. The atmosphere was surprisingly warm, filled with attention, knowledge, and genuine interest in the body and the person. Ariel generously shared his approach, every movement, every detail. It felt like a whole new world was opening up—subtle, sensual, and very conscious.

I learned an incredible amount. I realized how much of working with the face depends not on the strength of the touch, but on the quality of the touch. It's not just a technique — it's an art that requires inner silence and deep sensitivity.

I have also been to Ariel for massage several times, and that is a separate story. It is not massage in the usual sense, but something much deeper. A session with him is like a gentle return to your body. Tension disappears, inner anxiety goes away, and lightness, clarity, and warmth appear. You feel like you've been put back together again, but gently, as if nothing had been done — you've just suddenly become yourself.
I am immensely grateful for this experience and for being able to witness true mastery.

items.name: Irina
body: I recently completed training in osteopathic facial lifting with Ariel Pelevin, and although I have been working with the face for a long time and am well versed in various massage techniques, this approach was a real revelation for me.

This is not just a technique—it is a whole philosophy of touch. During the training, I felt that working with the face can be profound, conscious, and gentle. The atmosphere was warm, attentive, and very fulfilling. Ariel shared every movement and every detail with great generosity and respect for the body.

The most amazing thing is how my face has changed after practicing. The tension is gone, my features have softened, and my eyes have opened up. I feel a sense of inner lightness and freshness, which is reflected in my appearance.

And most importantly, I successfully apply this technique in my practice. The results on clients are amazing: the face literally comes to life, becomes more uniform, relaxed, and puffiness and tension disappear. This is truly deep work, and I am glad that I can now pass this state on to others.

items.name: Olga
body: The practice of osteolifting has changed my work as a cosmetologist, aesthetician, and massage therapist.
— Clients now note not only visible changes in their faces, but also a general feeling of relaxation, lightness, and "rejuvenation."
— The method has been smoothly integrated into my practice and has enhanced the results of my usual procedures, including myofascial techniques and treatments.
— I feel that my work has become deeper — thanks to listening, attentive touch, and a biodynamic approach that gives the body the opportunity to heal itself.
Thank you for the method in which silence speaks louder than words.

items.name: Natalia
body: Osteolifting practice as a completely painless method:
easily fits into my understanding of the environmental friendliness of body correction processes;
allows me to expand my work with clients (without contraindications or side effects);
improves results and enriches my professional arsenal of body therapy methods and techniques.

items.name: Xenia
body: I have been practicing natural facial rejuvenation for over 10 years. In 2012, I successfully completed four years of training in Chinese medicine and underwent an internship in China. My specialization includes rejuvenating acupuncture, cosmetology, various facial massage techniques, and osteo lifting. Osteo lifting, based on the principles of osteopathy, stimulates cell renewal, improves facial contours, and reduces signs of aging. This method has significantly improved the quality of my work and the results for my clients.

items.name: Svetlana
body: My name is Svetlana Dery. I am a cosmetologist with 22 years of experience and the owner of a successful clinic in Israel.
I try to keep up with the latest technologies in cosmetology.
I am proud to be a graduate of the Osteo-Lifting Academy under the guidance of Dr. Ariel Pelevin and can now offer my patients a unique osteo-lifting method for maximum anti-aging results.
The main thing for me is to see results, and I can see them.
From my patients' reviews
"Wow, I look different—younger."
"My whole body says thank you."
"During the session, I saw different colors."
My patients suddenly feel long-forgotten emotions.
Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.

items.q: Is it possible for an ordinary person without medical education to learn Osteolifting?
items.a: Yes! Due to the specificity of the method, Osteolifting can be taught to absolutely anyone who is not related to massage and osteopathy.

items.q: Does osteolifting take away facial asymmetry?
items.a: Yes! And very effective in reducing facial asymmetry!

items.q: Can Osteolifting be used with children?
items.a: Yes! And if you combine it with Osteo-body, you'll get great results in posture alignment. Whether you're working with a child or an adult.

items.q: How often should an Osteolift be done?
items.a: Course of 4 sessions, once a week. For prophylaxis 1 session every two to three months.

items.q: Are supplementary materials (manuals) available for training?
items.a: Yes! Videos in good quality in all angles, in a telegram channel with lifetime access!

paragraphs: The latest therapeutic non-surgical technique for facial rejuvenation and correction.
Innovative and advanced approach in manual cosmetology and body therapy.
This technique improves muscle tone, tissue elasticity, blood circulation, and restores the facial oval by working on tissues at all levels (skin, muscles, fascia, bone structure).
Additional therapeutic effect also helps with neurological diseases, respiratory diseases (respiratory organs), injuries.
Face, neck, collar zone - these are the zones of our emotions: osteo-lifting restores your beauty, relieves stress, lifts your mood and improves your health!
method.blocksTitle: The osteo-lift consists of two blocks

blocks.title: Deep tissue facial release
blocks.html: This method is the most effective of all existing massage and structural practices. It is particularly effective for correcting facial oval and expression lines caused by fascial blocks and sticking of fascial layers.

blocks.title: Biodynamic facelift
blocks.html: The technique effectively addresses bony dysfunctions. It affects periosteum and fascial pulls and can be an excellent therapeutic and rejuvenating tool.

method.metaDescription: Innovative and advanced approach in manual cosmetology and body therapy. Two blocks: deep tissue facial release and biodynamic facelift.
